name: curated-public-metadata-v2
purpose: Source-attributed public MCP tool metadata negative control. It measures whether MCPSentinel invents unbounded-risk findings from ordinary documented tools; it does not label a source project or tool as vulnerable.

labeling.rubric: A case is labelled with a rule only when its exposed metadata itself advertises that rule's unbounded-risk condition. The selected documented tools do not do so, therefore every expected rule set is empty.

sources.extraction: FastMCP-decorated function name plus first docstring paragraph
literal mcp.Tool name plus default English Description argument
